name: Calilio
summary: Cloud phone system with international numbers and call menus, priced per user. Numbers, minutes and SMS meter separately from a credit balance, so an active team's real bill sits above the per-seat price.
best_for: startups and small teams that want a modern, affordable cloud phone system with international numbers and clean dashboards
skip_if: you need a battle-tested enterprise contact center with deep integrations and SLAs, or your call volume makes metered credits unpredictable
honest_knock: The subscription is the platform, not the talking: numbers, minutes and SMS meter separately from a credit balance, so an active calling team's real bill sits meaningfully above the per-seat sticker — model a month of your actual call volume before comparing vendors. It's a young player in a crowded VoIP field; the price is keen, so test call quality on your real routes in the trial.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per user a month billed annually ($15 monthly)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17; plan prices unchanged on 2026-10-06, included allowance changed) Standard $15 per user/mo, or $12 billed annually ($144 a year); Premium $35 per user/mo, or $28 annually ($336 a year); Enterprise custom. Annual billing saves 20%. Each plan now includes a monthly allowance for US and Canada numbers: on Standard 200 outgoing and 100 incoming minutes plus 100 outbound and 100 inbound SMS, on Premium 1,000 and 500 minutes plus 500 and 500 SMS. With free minutes of call recording, call storage, AI transcription and AI voice agent and one free UK, US or Canada number added, the page values the bundle at $12.52 on Standard and $59.74 on Premium (read 6 October 2026; in August it quoted $6.75 and $33.74 for calls and SMS alone). Beyond the allowance, calls and SMS draw from a wallet: the subscription includes a $1 credit, after which you must load the wallet, and further numbers are billed separately. Standard has a 10-user limit; Premium has none. Standard suits solopreneurs and small businesses; Premium is aimed at growing businesses, franchises and call centres. Re-read 10 October 2026: the amounts are unchanged. Standard is capped at 10 users (User Limit: 10) and Premium has unlimited users; IVR with business hours, call transfer, a power dialer, bulk SMS and live call monitoring are listed under Premium, not Standard. The page mentions no shared inbox.
